title: Conrad Hotels & Resorts Expands its 1/3/5 Program to Help Guests Maximize Their Time and Experience Local Cultures
summary: Conrad Hotels & Resorts debuts new culturally‑inspired experiences as part of Conrad 1/3/5, individually curated by each hotel's concierge.
body_markdown:
Listen to this article


0:00


Spanning destinations across five continents, Conrad's concierge‑led cultural itineraries help luxury travelers make every hour count


- **Conrad Hotels & Resorts debuts new culturally-inspired experiences as part of Conrad 1/3/5, a signature global framework that transforms the modern traveler’s limited time into intentional, concierge-curated moments of cultural discovery.**
- **The program offers a curated offering of experiences categorized by one, three, or five-hour time windows, allowing guests to seamlessly adapt their cultural engagement to their specific travel itineraries.**
- **Each itinerary is uniquely crafted by the hotel’s dedicated concierge - the ultimate destination insider - to reveal the authentic character of the destination, ranging from indigenous traditions and artisanal crafts to specialized culinary and wellness experiences, through thoughtfully curated experiences tailored to the modern traveler.**
- **Spanning properties across five continents, this global initiative positions Conrad as a premier curator of culture that empowers guests to connect deeply with the local essence of each location through sophisticated and personalized travel moments.**


**MCLEAN, Va.** — Luxury travelers today aren't necessarily looking for more time—they're looking to make the time they have more meaningful.[Conrad Hotels & Resorts](https://www.hilton.com/en/brands/conrad-hotels/) has answered that shift with Conrad 1/3/5, a signature global brand program that turns one hour, three hours, or five hours into intentional moments of cultural discovery. Individually curated by each hotel's concierge, the experiences are designed to adapt to the pace of every stay while revealing the distinctive character of each destination through local traditions, artisans, cuisine, wellness, and discovery.


With a global footprint spanning five continents, Conrad has solidified its positioning as a premier curator of culture, offering more than accommodation. The Conrad 1/3/5 program is designed to encourage fresh perspectives with immersive, thoughtfully selected experiences for the modern traveler. The culturally-driven approach to travel allows guests to engage with a destination’s true essence at their own pace, with Conrad at the intersection of bold design, purposeful service, and local immersion.


"Today's luxury traveler isn't simply looking to see more; they want to connect more deeply, even when time is limited," said Dino Michael, senior vice president and global head, Hilton Luxury Brands. "Conrad 1/3/5 reflects a simple idea: exceptional hospitality should adapt to the way our guests actually travel. Whether someone has an hour between meetings or an entire day to explore, we've created a framework that makes meaningful cultural discovery feel effortless, personal and distinctly Conrad."


## One Program, Global Scale


Rooted in the idea that time is a traveler's most valuable luxury, Conrad 1/3/5 is activated differently at each property with the same time windows (one hour, three hours, and five hours), through the cultural and local lens of each destination. From one-hour snapshots to five-hour excursions, the following selection highlights the different ways Conrad delivers on authentic local traditions and modern experiences across its worldwide properties.


Available at the Concierge desk and bookable on each property’s website, the Conrad 1/3/5 program is localized to each destination, and every hotel brings the concept to life in its own distinctive and culturally relevant way.


### 1 Hour: Quick Cultural Snapshots


Impactful, local engagements for the busy traveler.


-


Conrad Hong Kong - A Taste of a Hong Kong Signature


-


Conrad Hong Kong - Discover the Local Neighborhood


-


Conrad Hong Kong - Art & Culture Immersive Journey


- Guests who have one hour for a local immersion at **Conrad Hong Kong** can participate in **A Taste of a Hong Kong Signature** where they will learn to craft Hong Kong’s beloved street treat, golden egg puffs, under the guidance of Conrad Hong Kong's chef, while uncovering the stories behind these nostalgic flavours. Adding a modern twist, guests will be among the first to create the signature “croffle” — the hotel’s pioneering creation in Hong Kong, blending the crisp texture of an egg puff with the buttery layers of a croissant.
- Guests of **[Conrad Washington, DC](https://www.hilton.com/en/hotels/wascici-conrad-washington-dc/experiences/)** can savor a true taste of the Chesapeake during a one-hour **Oysters & Wine Tasting Experience** at Estuary. This curated session features locally harvested, freshly shucked oysters paired with exceptional Virginia sparkling wine, celebrating the region’s rich coastal and viticultural heritage in the heart of the nation’s capital.
- While staying at[Conrad Rabat Arzana](https://www.hilton.com/en/hotels/rbacici-conrad-rabat-arzana/experiences/) , **** guests with one hour can embark on a serene **Horseback Ride by the Ocean** along the beach at Oued Ikkem. Partnering with the local equestrian club, this experience allows guests to immerse themselves in nature with minimal travel while feeling the breeze, the rhythm of the waves, and the soothing presence of a majestic horse.
- At[Conrad Singapore Marina Bay](https://www.hilton.com/en/hotels/sincici-conrad-singapore-marina-bay/experiences/) , guests can embark on a **Curated Art & Tea Pairing** and explore highlights from the hotel’s collection of more than 3,400 artworks on a self–guided journey that will showcase the works of local and international artists. Each piece reflects the dialogue between local heritage and global perspectives, offering a quiet moment of discovery. The experience concludes at Lobby Lounge with a curated tea pairing, where guests can enjoy signature teas thoughtfully selected to complement the artworks from the tour.


### 3 Hours: Half-Day Immersion


Culturally-driven experiences to explore local traditions.


Conrad Athens The llisian - Olfactive Seminar


- Guests of[Conrad Athens The Ilisian](https://www.hilton.com/en/hotels/athgrci-conrad-athens-the-ilisian/experiences/) can explore the art of Greek perfumery through an immersive **Olfactive Seminar** at The Naxos Apothecary, where Aegean botanicals and century-old traditions create a sensory journey rooted in the culture and spirit of Athens. ****
- At[Conrad Nashville](https://www.hilton.com/en/hotels/bnaleci-conrad-nashville/experiences/) , guests can participate in an unforgettable evening during the **Woodworth Theater Experience** where they will immerse in the rich history and vibrant energy of Nashville through exclusive access, elevated dining, and intimate live entertainment. From a private tour of the historic Woolworth Theatre to personalized VIP touches and curated culinary experiences at Marquee, the evening is designed to feel both luxurious and deeply connected to the city’s cultural legacy.
- Guests of[Conrad Osaka](https://www.hilton.com/en/hotels/osacici-conrad-osaka/experiences/) can take three hours to discover Ura-Tenma, Osaka’s beloved hidden dining district where locals truly come alive. Just streets away from the city’s polished skyline, this vibrant neighborhood invites you to experience a more authentic side of Osaka through an unforgettable **Izakaya Hopping Journey** . From intimate sake spots like Azuki-iron no Marcus, to timeless flavors at Sushikin, and bold, characterful venues such as Black Sheep—each stop reveals a different layer of the city’s nightlife culture.


### 5 Hours: Full-Day Excursions


Deep connections and unforgettable, in-depth exploration.


Conrad Nagoya - Aritmatsu Shibori


- Guests of **[Conrad Nagoya](https://www.hilton.com/en/hotels/ngocici-conrad-nagoya/experiences/)** can immerse in the 400-year-old tradition of **Arimatsu Shibori** (tie-dyeing) at its very birthplace. During this full day experience, guests will visit the historic merchant houses, enjoy moments of tranquility in a traditional tea room, experience artisan demonstrations, and participate in hands-on workshops. As a memento of the occasion, guests will take home the hand-dyed silk piece. This historic tie-dyeing technique is also incorporated into the design of Conrad Nagoya’s guest rooms and banquet halls, allowing its guests to experience a unique harmony between the stay and the local culture.
- At[Conrad Abu Dhabi Etihad Towers](https://www.hilton.com/en/hotels/auhetci-conrad-abu-dhabi-etihad-towers/experiences/) , guests can embark on a five-hour **Journey Through Abu Dhabi's Icons.** First, experience the grandeur of Qasr Al Watan, a Royal palace that offers a unique glimpse into the spirit of the UAE’s people and leaders. Then, visit the Sheikh Zayed Grand Mosque, an architectural marvel that unites people from all backgrounds to admire its beauty and learn about the region’s culture. End the journey with a visit to The Founder’s Memorial and reflect on the legacy of Sheikh Zayed and his vision for the UAE.
- Guests of[Conrad Orlando](https://www.hilton.com/en/hotels/orlcici-conrad-orlando/experiences/) can embark on a serene twilight paddle showcasing one of Orlando’s signature nature experiences during the **Signature Bioluminescence Immersion.** Glide across calm waters at dusk in a kayak, spotting coastal birds and occasional dolphins or manatees. As night falls, the water comes alive with the soft glow of seasonal bioluminescence, creating an unforgettable shimmering display.
- Guests of[Conrad Seoul](https://www.hilton.com/en/hotels/selcici-conrad-seoul/experiences/) can embark on the **Bukhansan Forest & Palace Journey** , and reconnect with nature through a restorative journey across Bukhansan National Park. During this experience, guests will follow sections of the Bukhansan Dullegil, a scenic perimeter path offering a more relaxed way to explore the mountain. As the route descends toward historic neighborhoods such as Bukchon and nearby palace districts, the experience gradually shifts from mountain paths to the layered streets of old Seoul.


Read more about Conrad Hotels & Resorts at[stories.hilton.com/brands/conrad-hotels](http://stories.hilton.com/brands/conrad-hotels) .


##### FAQ: Conrad Hotels & Resorts Unveils a New Era of Cultural Luxury with Its Global Conrad 1/3/5 Experience


Conrad 1/3/5 is a signature global framework designed to transform a traveler’s limited time into intentional, concierge-led moments of cultural discovery. By organizing experiences into one, three, and five-hour time windows, the program helps guests staying at a Conrad property to maximize their time and connect more deeply with a place.


The program offers a curated offering of locally-inspired experiences that guests can choose from based on their available time. Whether a traveler has an hour between meetings or a full afternoon to explore, the framework allows them to seamlessly integrate a selected cultural engagement into their individual travel itinerary.


Each 1/3/5 itinerary is uniquely selected by the hotel’s concierge team. Because they are designed locally, these experiences reveal the authentic character of each destination – ranging from indigenous traditions and artisanal crafts to specialized culinary and wellness adventures.


Conrad launched 1/3/5 to address the evolving needs of today’s luxury traveler, who is often looking to make their time while traveling more meaningful. The program reinforces Conrad's commitment to providing exceptional, adaptable hospitality that makes cultural connection feel effortless and personal, regardless of how much time a guest has to explore the destination.


All global Conrad Hotels & Resorts, spanning five continents, participate in the Conrad 1/3/5 program for guests. Every property localizes the 1/3/5 concept to showcase the specific culture and local essence of its unique destination.


Guests can access the curated offering of 1, 3, and 5-hour experiences directly at the Concierge desk at any Conrad location or on each individual property website.
